Class InsertionSort

java.lang.Object
org.troy.capstone.search_engine.sorting.InsertionSort
public class InsertionSort extends Object
This is used to sort a list of Rows based on a custom RowComparator. Source is https://www.geeksforgeeks.org/dsa/insertion-sort-algorithm/ and modified to fit the data structure and comparators used in the project.

  • Method Details

    • insertionSort

      @Deprecated @Generated public static void insertionSort(List<Row> rows, RowComparator comparator, LongWrapper time)
      Deprecated.
      This method is useful for analyzing the time taken, but is not used in main program execution.
      Sorts a list of Rows using the Insertion Sort algorithm based on the provided RowComparator. Only used for analysis so it is ignored in code coverage.
      Parameters:
      rows - The list of Rows to be sorted.
      comparator - The RowComparator used to compare the Rows for sorting.
      time - An optional LongWrapper to store the time taken to perform the sort. If null, time will not be recorded.
      Preconditions:
      comparator is a valid RowComparator that can compare the Rows in the list. The Rows in the list have the proper column that the comparator expects to compare.
      Postconditions:
      The list of Rows is sorted in place based on the order defined by the comparator.

    • insertionSort

      public static void insertionSort(List<Row> rows, RowComparator comparator)
      Sorts a list of Rows using the Insertion Sort algorithm based on the provided RowComparator. This method does not record the time taken for sorting.
      Parameters:
      rows - The list of Rows to be sorted.
      comparator - The RowComparator used to compare the Rows for sorting.
      Preconditions:
      comparator is a valid RowComparator that can compare the Rows in the list. The Rows in the list have the proper column that the comparator expects to compare.
      Postconditions:
      The list of Rows is sorted in place based on the order defined by the comparator.
